images.title: Sharing 8 tens and 3 ones among 6 plates
images.purpose: Show 83 as base ten blocks and the tens shared among 6 plates: 1 ten on each plate and 2 tens left over.
images.composition: The starting blocks on the left, six plates with one rod each in the middle, and the leftover rods on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Left group at x 60 to 560: 8 tens rods in a row, each rod a blue #0072B2 rectangle 28 px wide and 150 px high with 9 thin white lines across it dividing it into 10 equal parts, 14 px apart, from x 80, at y 190 to 340; under them 3 ones cubes in a row, each a reddish purple #CC79A7 square 36 px wide, 14 px apart, from x 80, at y 380 to 416. Above the left group the label 8 tens and 3 ones at x 310 and y 130 (40 px, dark). Middle group: 6 plates, each a white circle 150 px across with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline, in 2 rows of 3 with centres at (700, 250), (870, 250), (1040, 250), (700, 440), (870, 440) and (1040, 440); each plate holds exactly 1 blue tens rod, 16 px wide and 110 px high, centred on it. Above the plates the label 6 plates at x 870 and y 130. Right group: 2 blue tens rods, 28 px wide and 150 px high, side by side at x 1230 and x 1270, at y 190 to 340, with the label 2 tens left at x 1250 and y 390. Under the left group nothing else; the 3 ones cubes stay in the left group. Labels are dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Sharing 8 tens among 6 plates gives 1 ten to each plate and leaves 2 tens, which have to be regrouped into ones.
images.description: Base ten blocks for 83: 8 tens and 3 ones, six plates each with one ten, and 2 tens left over.
images.context: Concept image for Regroup and Share. The numbers are the plan's own worked example (83 shared among 6), not a number of any book question.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student how many tens are left over and what to do with them. The slip to watch: giving the leftover tens to some plates only.

image_decisions.why: The blocks shared among plates are the mathematics of sharing the tens first and regrouping the tens left over.
